function.name: game_scores_get
function.description: Retrieve scores and rankings based on player’s performance in a certain game. Unlike game_rewards_get, which retrieves rewards in a game, this retrieves scores and rankings.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

level.description: The level of the game for which you want to retrieve the scores.

player.description: The name of the player for whom you want to retrieve scores. Default ''

function.name: game_rewards_get
function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Unlike game_scores_get, which retrieves scores and rankings, this retrieves rewards.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

mission.description: The mission for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

trophy.description: The trophy level for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

function.name: game_missions_list
function.description: List all missions for a certain game. Unlike game_scores_get, which retrieves scores and rankings, this lists missions.
